chunks: And every morning they asked forgiveness,

key_terms.الْبُكُورُ: the early morning hours, specifically before dawn
key_terms.وَالْأَسْحَارِ: the late night/early morning hours (variant reading)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about seeking forgiveness in the early morning?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often linked to the practice of the Ahl al-Bayt, particularly Imam Ali and Imam al-Sadiq, who would recite it during their night prayers (Tahajjud) before Fajr. It underscores the concept of *Istighfar* not merely as a verbal request but as a continuous state of spiritual awareness and purification that characterizes the devout. This timing highlights the transition from the solitude of the night to the public worship of the day, marking a moment of divine connection before engaging with the world.
